title: When waiting starts souring the heart
issueStatement: Time is passing, but the inner room is not staying open. Delay has started feeding irritation, private urgency, and the fear that faithfulness is being wasted.
centralInsight: Gurbani does not treat patience as limp delay. Patience ripens where remembrance steadies the body, sangat cools the mind, and the soul stops demanding immediate proof.
practicalReflection: Impatience is often grief mixed with self-importance. The question is not only whether the outcome changes, but whether the heart remains teachable while it waits.
actionPrompt: Stay with one faithful act for the next seven days, and measure the waiting by honesty of heart rather than speed of result.
searchTerms: building a practice that can really wait
